how: Cloudflare's GraphQL Analytics API on the account the spike ran on, filtered to the spike's own container application, Worker script and buckets (their identifiers are kept outside this repository). Datasets: containersUsageAdaptiveGroups (sum: txBytes, cpuTimeSec, allocatedMemory, allocatedDisk; it has no field for bytes received), containersMetricsAdaptiveGroups (sum: rxBytes, txBytes), workersInvocationsAdaptive (sum: requests, cpuTimeUs), r2OperationsAdaptiveGroups (sum: requests by actionType), r2BandwidthUsageAdaptiveGroups (sum: bytesUpload, bytesDownload). The billing API (/accounts/{id}/billing/usage, /billing/usage/paygo) answered 403 to the spike's token, so the invoice itself was not read.
